title: Evidence, context, and citations
subtitle: Turn ranked hits into bounded material a person can verify.
goal: Turn retrieved passages into an answer the reader can verify
intro: A list of search hits is not yet a trustworthy reading packet for the model.
terms: Whether a fact fits this task
case: A long document produces many overlapping hits.
The packet should include diverse necessary facts rather than repeat one sentence.
A token cap can accidentally remove the decisive exception.
